headlines.text: 2020 brought us this moment: the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as Omega & Page vs. The Natural Nightmares went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.31. It was the first title opportunity of The Natural Nightmares's career. This stood as the 10th match in AEW World Tag Team Titles history ? a nice marker in that championship's story. A well-worked opener with real family drama in the background ? QT Marshall's crush on Allie kept things personal on the outside, while inside the ring, Dustin Rhodes turned back the clock with an impressive hurricanrana before the champions closed it out with their Buckshot/V-Trigger combo.

Rewind to 2023, when the AEW TNT Title found a new home as Luchasaurus vs. Wardlow battled it out, appearing on Collision, rated 5.15 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. In the first-ever match on AEW Collision, Christian Cage's interference ? smashing a ringside camera over Wardlow's head ? let Luchasaurus steal the TNT Championship, a shock title win nobody in the arena saw coming.
2026 brought us this moment: Mercedes Mone vs. Hazuki met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match on Dynamite, rated 8.94 ? a genuine showstealer.

secondaries.text: That Friday in 2022, Darby Allin vs. Bobby Fish locked horns for the first time, topping the bill that night on Rampage, rated 7.16 ? a match that delivered.
Looking back to 2020, when Ricky Starks laced up for their first AEW match against Cody, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.21.
2023 brought us this moment: Bullet Club Gold & Joe announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.74 ? a solid showing.
